imagery_intro: Imagery under the OSM data. Tiles come from the provider's server once you choose a layer.
imagery_automated: Backgrounds are off in automated browsers, except a template on this machine (a link with `bg=custom:` to localhost).
imagery_list_failed: The list of backgrounds could not be loaded.
imagery_none_cover: No background covers this view at this zoom.
imagery_chosen_out_of_view: The chosen background does not cover this view at this zoom. It stays on the map.
imagery_oam_description: Drone and aerial images, drawn above the background.
imagery_template_key_hint: This template has a part that looks like a key ({names}). A shared link includes the template, so it shares that key too.
imagery_token_example_tms: TMS: \{-y} counts rows from the south
imagery_more_tokens: Also: \{switch:a,b,c} for several hosts, \{u} for quadkey tiles, \{@2x} or \{r} for retina tiles. Not supported: \{w}, \{s}, \{n} and \{e}, which MapLibre has no token for.
imagery_rights: You are responsible for having the right to use this imagery. Check the provider’s terms.
imagery_oam_zoom_in: Zoom in to list the OpenAerialMap images of this area.
imagery_oam_failed: The OpenAerialMap images could not be loaded.
imagery_oam_none: No OpenAerialMap image in this view.
imagery_refuse_scheme: The template must start with https:// or http://.
imagery_refuse_brace: A brace has no partner: each \{ needs a } after it, and a } needs a \{.
imagery_refuse_retired: {token} is not supported: MapLibre has no token for it. Use \{bbox} for a WMS template.
imagery_refuse_switch_hosts: \{switch:…} needs one or more hosts, separated by commas, with none left empty.
imagery_refuse_wms_only: {token} is only used in a WMS template, together with \{bbox}.
imagery_refuse_no_address: Use \{z}, \{x} and \{y} for tiles, \{u} for quadkeys, or \{bbox} for WMS.
imagery_refuse_two_kinds: Use one kind of address in a template: \{z}, \{x} and \{y}, or \{u}, or \{bbox}.
imagery_refuse_not_web: This is not a web address.
imagery_offset_intro: Use this when the imagery and the OSM data do not line up. Move the imagery in small steps, or enter the offset in meters, east and north of its place.
imagery_offset_field: Imagery offset in meters, east and north
imagery_offset_invalid: Enter two numbers in meters, east and north, separated by a comma. An empty field resets the offset.
imagery_overlays_intro: Layers of the imagery index, drawn over the background: borders, parcels, routes, checks.
